files.COLORS.md:
# Native note colors and note actions

Right-click the non-editor part of a note (header padding/icon, border/footer)
to open its color palette. Right-click title/body retains the browser's
copy/paste/spelling menu. The footer Note actions button also opens the palette
for keyboard/touch access. Arrow keys, Home/End navigate; Enter/Space select;
Escape/Tab dismiss and return focus. Outside click, blur, scroll or resize
dismiss. Menu placement is clamped to the viewport. It uses menuitemradio roles,
selection checks, names and swatches, not color-only controls.

Native facet: desk.note-style = {"color": "blue"}.
Allowed values: yellow (default), green, blue, pink, lavender, gray.
No facet means yellow. Light/dark tokens are defined by the view. Changing a
color does not modify core.appearance, core.title, or core.text. Agents can
change the same facet with world.transact using the current object revision;
no package edit is needed for a palette selection. Adding a new palette color
would require revising both schema and renderer.

Color writes reuse the geometry writer's serialized presentation slot, called
positionPromise for compatibility. It waits for in-flight text writes; text
writes wait for it. The menu-opening style baseline is checked against the
latest projection before native CAS. Refused/stale writes are not rebased or
retried; the last confirmed appearance and an error are shown. Dirty text
baselines remain separate. Colors render only from confirmed projections.

An open menu blocks safe-reload preparation. A selected color closes the menu,
then its pending write is flushed by the existing reload handshake. DOM nodes,
editor selection, stacking, chat and unsent drafts are not replaced.

Tests: tests/corner_color_browser.py, plus existing drag/snap/stack suites.
Run with the entry path using Playwright/Chromium as in DRAGGING.md.
Tests use a simulated parent bridge; live-host activation/persistence and
physical mobile/other-browser behavior need independent verification.
files.DRAGGING.md:
# Note header dragging

The installed entry remains `index.html`, communicating with Agora through its
existing parent-frame bridge. No host checkout or bundled default shell is used.

## Interaction
- On the free-position desktop desk, drag the header padding or its existing
  note icon. Title and body inputs remain native text-editing/selection targets.
- Movement begins after 5 CSS pixels. Pointer capture keeps tracking outside
  the card. Escape, pointer cancellation/capture loss, window blur, hidden
  document, and resize cancel the uncommitted preview.
- Tab to the note icon: arrows move 10px; Shift + arrows move 1px.
- Touch dragging on the wide desk uses the icon only. Other header areas and
  editors keep native scrolling/selection. At widths <=750px, the original
  stacked mobile layout is unchanged and free-position dragging is disabled.
- Coordinates are desk-relative (including scroll offset), rounded and clamped
  to 0..100000. The desk extents grow with a preview.

## Persistence and concurrency
Only pointer-up after movement or an arrow-key move requests a native
`world.transact` patch of `core.appearance`, preserving scene/size and checking
the expected object revision. There is no DOM-only persistence or localStorage.
A separate latest projection and text baseline protect in-progress text edits.
Position writes serialize with existing text writes; a newer appearance cannot
be silently adopted as the baseline for an old gesture. Refused/stale writes
are not retried: the latest available confirmed position is displayed with a
visible error. A failed follow-up read retains the last confirmed projection.
A transport timeout may have committed remotely; it is never called a success
without confirmation.

Refreshes do not replace nodes or snap an active preview. Older object
projections are ignored. The existing safe-reload prepare/ready/cancel protocol
is retained: active gestures reject reload preparation; pending moves and text/
chat drafts are flushed before ready; failures/deadlines preserve and thaw the
old view. No new host-level reload mechanism is introduced.

## Regression tests
`tests/drag_browser.py` loads the exact entry in Chromium with a simulated
parent-frame bridge, isolated test objects, and real browser pointer events.
It NEVER connects to or mutates a live Agora world.

After exporting the retained package files into a Linux test directory:
```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install playwright
.venv/bin/playwright install --with-deps chromium
.venv/bin/python tests/drag_browser.py index.html
```

Verified in the designated Linux guest: preview/one-CAS-write, reopen
persistence, title selection/editing, focused editor selection and chat/draft
retention, text/move serialization, concurrent appearance and text conflicts,
refusal and stale projection handling, pointer cancellation/capture loss,
scroll coordinates, keyboard movement, wide-desk touch pointer movement,
mobile stacked-layout behavior, and reload ready/refusal/deadline/thaw.
Desktop layout was visually inspected in guest Chromium.

These tests are not evidence of live-host browser end-to-end behavior.
Independent verification remains needed for the installed running browser's
bridge/reload activation, actual durable note move/reopen, and physical mobile
devices/other browsers. Browser package.build only validates entry/manifest.
files.RESIZING.md:
# Note corner resizing

The retained agora.shell entry now has four subtle corner grips on the
free-position desk (>750px). Drag any corner; the opposite corner stays fixed.
Minimum size is 160 × 140 CSS pixels, maximum 100000 × 100000. Top/left
expansion stops at the desk origin for ordinary nonnegative-position notes.
Tab to a corner and use arrows to move it by 10px (Shift: 1px).
Escape, cancellation, capture loss, blur, hidden document, and viewport resize
discard the preview. A movement threshold avoids writes on a plain click.
Only the grips claim touch gestures; text editors retain selection/scrolling.
At narrow mobile widths, controls are hidden and the existing stacked layout
remains unchanged (saved desktop geometry is not changed).

Resizing shares header dragging's gesture lifecycle and serialized CAS writer,
rather than introducing a second persistence or reload mechanism.
Pointer release saves width/height and position atomically in core.appearance.
The original scene is preserved. Concurrent appearance changes are not rebased
or retried; refusal/staleness restores the latest confirmed geometry and shows
an error. Text baselines, editor nodes/selection and chat drafts are preserved.
Active resizing blocks reload preparation; pending geometry saves are flushed
by the existing safe-reload handshake.

## Verification
Run tests/drag_browser.py as documented in DRAGGING.md. It tests the exact
retained entry using Chromium and a simulated parent bridge, never live notes.
All existing drag tests and new resize tests passed in the designated Linux
guest: four corners, preview/one CAS request/reopen, opposite-corner anchoring,
size/edge bounds, keyboard/no-op, focus/selection/chat/drafts, cancellation,
remote geometry conflicts and refusal/stale projection, text-write serialization,
reload refusal/flush/thaw, touch events and narrow stacked layout.
The resized desktop layout was visually inspected in Chromium.
A regression found Escape was not delivered when the first interaction focused
no frame editor; pointer gestures now focus the frame window without replacing
the active editor or its selection. Regression tests passed with this fix.

Not verified here: installed host-browser activation, the live parent bridge's
durable save/reopen cycle, physical touch devices and other browsers.
files.SNAPPING.md:
# Note adjacency snapping

On the wide/free-position desk, header pointer dragging snaps a note alongside
another when its proposed edge is within 12 CSS pixels of a 12px gap.
All four sides are supported. Nearby leading/trailing edges align within
the same 12px threshold; otherwise partial side overlap is enough.
The closest valid candidate wins; ties follow stable note iteration order.
Distant notes do not attract one another. Snaps outside desk position bounds
are rejected. A dashed outline marks an active snapped preview.

Move beyond the threshold to pull away, or hold Alt to bypass snapping.
Keyboard movement and corner resizing remain precise and unsnapped.
The narrow (<=750px) stacked mobile desk is unchanged.

Snapping is a one-time positioning aid, NOT a maintained relationship:
neighbors are never moved or written, and later moving/resizing either note
does not reposition the other. Only a completed drag writes the resulting
native core.appearance position through the existing serialized CAS writer.
Cancellation, refusal, stale writes, editing/drafts and safe reload keep the
existing drag behavior. Neighbor geometry is read from the visible desk during
preview and release; it is not transactionally locked to the dragged note.

## Tests
Run both tests with Playwright/Chromium (see DRAGGING.md setup):
  python tests/snap_browser.py index.html
  python tests/drag_browser.py index.html

Tests use a simulated parent bridge and no live world mutations. Snap tests
cover all sides, 12px gap, preview/one-CAS-write/reopen, unchanged neighbors,
alignment/unequal dimensions/partial overlap/proximity/bounds, pull-away/Alt,
cancellation/refusal/concurrent source writes, drafts/focus, and unchanged
resize, keyboard and mobile behavior. The existing suite covers drag/resize
editing, cancellation, conflicts and safe-reload regression.

Live-host activation and native bridge save/reopen, physical touch devices and
other browsers require independent verification.

## Two-sided corners
Compatible horizontal and vertical adjacency constraints now combine, with a
12px gap to both neighbors. Two-side candidates take priority over single-side
alignment, then nearest pointer distance breaks ties. Both orthogonal overlaps
are checked at the final coordinates; non-overlapping distant edges cannot
form a corner. Alt bypass and release/CAS persistence are unchanged.
files.STACKING.md:
# Bring notes to front

Press an exposed part of an overlapping note to bring it above other notes.
Keyboard focus also raises a note. Recent stacking order is preserved until
the view is reopened. No geometry/content writes occur just to raise a note.

Implementation: one shared delegated pointerdown/focusin handler, eight lines
including its comment, in index.html. It assigns bounded z-index ranks above
the existing drag/resize layer, preserving relative order of the other notes.
It never reorders DOM nodes, prevents default editing, or changes selection.
Stacking remains independent of geometry refreshes; safe reload stays intact.

This is ephemeral interaction state, not a persisted layout setting. If the
user later asks for saved layering, introduce a schema-backed layer contract
and CAS persistence deliberately, rather than writing to core.appearance
with an unsupported field.

tests/stack_browser.py uses the retained shell in Chromium and the same
simulated parent bridge as the other suites. Run it with the entry path:
python tests/stack_browser.py index.html
It does not verify activation in the user's running host browser.

"""Corner snapping and native-shaped note style tests; simulated bridge."""
import asyncio
from drag_browser import HTML, BRIDGE
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
BRIDGE=BRIDGE.replace("items:[copy(objects.n)]","items:Object.values(objects).filter(o=>o.facets['core.appearance']).map(copy)")
BRIDGE=BRIDGE.replace("c=>c.facets['core.appearance']","c=>c.facets['core.appearance']||c.facets['desk.note-style']")
N='[data-object-id="n"]'
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  browser=await pw.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
  errors=[]
  async def setup(width=1800,dark=False):
   p=await browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':1000},color_scheme='dark' if dark else 'light')
   p.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
   await p.route('http://localhost/**',lambda r:r.fulfill(content_type='text/html',body=HTML if r.request.url.endswith('/shell') else BRIDGE))
   await p.goto('http://localhost/');f=p.frames[1]
   await f.wait_for_function('state.draftLoaded && state.connected')
   return p,f
  async def settle(f):
   await f.wait_for_function('[...state.notes.values()].every(e=>!e.positionPromise && !e.savePromise)')
  async def xy(f):
   return await f.locator(N).evaluate('(e)=>[parseFloat(e.style.left),parseFloat(e.style.top)]')
  async def start(p,f,x,y):
   b=await f.locator(N+' .note-header').bounding_box()
   sx,sy=b['x']+32,b['y']+6
   await p.mouse.move(sx,sy);await p.mouse.down();await p.mouse.move(sx+x-20,sy+y-20,steps=5)
  async def menu(p,f):
   b=await f.locator(N+' .note-header').bounding_box()
   await p.mouse.click(b['x']+32,b['y']+6,button='right')
   await f.wait_for_selector('#note-menu:not([hidden])')
  async def choose(f,color):
   await f.locator('#note-menu [data-color="'+color+'"]').click()
  async def writes(p):
   return await p.evaluate("requests.filter(r=>r.method==='world.transact')")

  for h,v in [('left','above'),('right','above'),('left','below'),('right','below')]:
   p,f=await setup()
   await p.evaluate("""([h,v])=>{
    for(const [id,x,y] of [['q',h==='left'?93:607,240],['r',300,v==='above'?83:517]]) {
     objects[id]=copy(objects.n);objects[id].id=id;Object.assign(objects[id].facets['core.appearance'],{x,y});
    }
   }""",[h,v])
   await f.evaluate('refresh()')
   await start(p,f,355,307)
   assert await xy(f)==[350,300],(h,v,await xy(f))
   assert len(await writes(p))==0
   await p.keyboard.down('Alt');assert await xy(f)==[355,307]
   await p.keyboard.up('Alt');assert await xy(f)==[350,300]
   await p.mouse.up();await settle(f)
   req=(await writes(p))[0]['args']['changes']
   assert len(req)==1 and req[0]['id']=='n' and req[0]['expected_revision']==1
   assert await p.evaluate("objects.q.revision===1 && objects.r.revision===1")
   # Incompatible orthogonal neighbor cannot pull a corner through empty space.
   await f.evaluate("paintGeometry(state.notes.get('r'),{x:0,y:83,width:245,height:205})")
   assert await f.evaluate("snapNotePosition(state.notes.get('n'),{x:355,y:307},245,205)")==dict(x=350,y=307,snapped=True)
   await p.close()
  print('PASS all four two-neighbor corners, offset edges, Alt bypass, one CAS write, final-overlap validation',flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  before=await p.evaluate('copy(objects.n)')
  await f.locator(N+' .note-body').focus()
  await f.locator(N+' .note-body').evaluate('(e)=>e.setSelectionRange(2,8)')
  await menu(p,f)
  assert await f.locator('#note-menu [aria-checked="true"]').inner_text()=='Yellow'
  await choose(f,'blue');await settle(f)
  assert await f.locator(N).get_attribute('data-color')=='blue'
  assert await f.locator(N+' .note-body').evaluate('(e)=>document.activeElement===e && e.selectionStart===2 && e.selectionEnd===8')
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['desk.note-style']")==dict(color='blue')
  req=(await writes(p))[0]['args']['changes'][0]
  assert req['expected_revision']==1 and list(req['facets'])==['desk.note-style']
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['core.appearance']")==before['facets']['core.appearance']
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['core.text']")==before['facets']['core.text']
  assert await f.locator('#chat-input').input_value()=='Existing unsent draft'
  # Reopen with the retained world projection.
  await p.evaluate("document.querySelector('iframe').remove();let f=document.createElement('iframe');f.src='/shell';document.body.append(f)")
  f=p.frames[1];await f.wait_for_selector(N)
  assert await f.locator(N).get_attribute('data-color')=='blue'
  await p.close()
  print('PASS right-click color, isolated facet CAS, unchanged text/geometry/drafts, selection restored, reopen',flush=True)

  for mode in ['refuse','stale','projected']:
   p,f=await setup()
   await menu(p,f)
   if mode=='refuse':await p.evaluate('refuse=true')
   else:
    await p.evaluate("objects.n.revision++;objects.n.facets['desk.note-style']={color:'pink'}")
    if mode=='projected':await f.evaluate('refresh()')
   await choose(f,'blue');await settle(f)
   assert await f.locator(N).get_attribute('data-color')==('yellow' if mode=='refuse' else 'pink')
   assert await f.locator('.note-move-status').inner_text()=='Color failed'
   assert len(await writes(p))==(0 if mode=='projected' else 1)
   assert await f.locator('#notice').is_visible()
   await p.close()
  print('PASS refused/stale/menu-opening-baseline conflicts never overwrite newer color',flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  await f.evaluate("document.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>window.lastContextPrevented=e.defaultPrevented)")
  await f.locator(N+' .note-title').click(button='right')
  assert not await f.evaluate('window.lastContextPrevented')
  assert not await f.locator('#note-menu').is_visible()
  await p.keyboard.press('Escape')
  await f.locator(N+' .note-actions').focus();await p.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await f.wait_for_selector('#note-menu:not([hidden])')
  await p.keyboard.press('End')
  assert await f.locator('#note-menu [data-color="gray"]').evaluate('(e)=>document.activeElement===e')
  await p.keyboard.press('Home');await p.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');await p.keyboard.press('Enter');await settle(f)
  assert await f.locator(N).get_attribute('data-color')=='green'
  await menu(p,f);await p.keyboard.press('Escape')
  assert not await f.locator('#note-menu').is_visible()
  await menu(p,f);await p.mouse.click(900,100)
  assert not await f.locator('#note-menu').is_visible()
  await menu(p,f)
  await f.evaluate("prepareReload('open-menu')")
  await p.wait_for_function("replies.some(r=>r.id==='open-menu')")
  assert await p.evaluate("!!replies.find(r=>r.id==='open-menu').error")
  await p.keyboard.press('Escape')
  assert not await f.locator('#app').evaluate('(e)=>e.inert')
  await p.close()
  print('PASS native editor context menu; keyboard actions/arrows/Home/End/Escape, outside dismissal, active-menu reload refusal',flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  await p.evaluate('delayText=400;delayMove=350')
  await f.locator(N+' .note-body').fill('Edited before color')
  await menu(p,f);await choose(f,'lavender')
  await f.locator(N+' .note-body').fill('Newer text during color save')
  await f.evaluate("void prepareReload('color-pending')")
  await p.wait_for_function("replies.some(r=>r.id==='color-pending')")
  assert await p.evaluate("!!replies.find(r=>r.id==='color-pending').result?.ready")
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['core.text'].text")=='Newer text during color save'
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['desk.note-style'].color")=='lavender'
  await f.evaluate("cancelReload('color-pending')")
  assert not await f.locator('#app').evaluate('(e)=>e.inert')
  await p.close()
  print('PASS text/color/newer-text serialization and safe-reload flush/thaw',flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  await f.locator(N+' .note-body').fill('Keep my draft')
  await p.evaluate("objects.n.revision++;objects.n.facets['core.text'].text='Remote body'")
  await f.evaluate('refresh()')
  await menu(p,f);await choose(f,'gray');await settle(f)
  assert await f.locator(N+' .note-body').input_value()=='Keep my draft'
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['core.text'].text")=='Remote body'
  assert await f.evaluate("state.notes.get('n').conflict")
  await p.close()
  print('PASS color does not bless conflicting remote text baseline',flush=True)

  for dark in [False,True]:
   p,f=await setup(width=390,dark=dark)
   for color in ['green','blue','pink','lavender','gray','yellow']:
    await f.locator(N+' .note-actions').click()
    await choose(f,color);await settle(f)
    assert await f.locator(N).get_attribute('data-color')==color
   await f.locator(N+' .note-actions').click()
   box=await f.locator('#note-menu').bounding_box()
   assert box['x']>=0 and box['x']+box['width']<=390 and box['y']+box['height']<=1000
   assert await f.locator(N).evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).position')=='relative'
   await p.close()
  print('PASS six palettes, narrow mobile button/menu bounds, light and dark render paths',flush=True)
  assert not errors,errors
  await browser.close()
  print('ALL CORNER/COLOR TESTS PASSED; simulated bridge, not live host',flush=True)

"""Browser regression tests for the retained shell (simulated parent bridge).
Run: python tests/drag_browser.py [path/to/index.html]
Requires Playwright and its Chromium. Does not write to a live Agora world.
"""
import asyncio, json, pathlib, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

HTML = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else pathlib.Path(__file__).parents[1]/'index.html').read_text()
BRIDGE = r"""<!doctype html><style>body{margin:0}iframe{width:100vw;height:100vh;border:0}</style>
<script>
const copy=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
window.objects = {
 n:{id:'n',revision:1,facets:{'core.title':{text:'A title to edit'},'core.text':{text:'Keep this note body'},'core.appearance':{scene:'desk',x:20,y:20,width:245,height:205}}},
 'shell.chat-draft':{id:'shell.chat-draft',revision:1,facets:{'core.text':{text:'Existing unsent draft'},'core.draft':{conversation:'main'}}}
};
window.requests=[]; window.replies=[]; window.delayMove=0; window.delayText=0; window.refuse=false;
window.addEventListener('message',async event=>{
 const d=event.data;if(!d.agora)return;
 if(d.event){replies.push(d);return;}
 requests.push(copy(d));
 let result,error;
 try {
  if(d.method==='world.query') result={items:[copy(objects.n)],complete:true};
  else if(d.method==='world.get') {if(!objects[d.args.id])throw Error('not found');result=copy(objects[d.args.id]);}
  else if(d.method==='world.transact'){
   const moving=d.args.changes.some(c=>c.facets['core.appearance']);
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,moving?delayMove:delayText));
   if(moving&&refuse)throw Error('Write refused for test');
   for(const c of d.args.changes)if((objects[c.id]?.revision||0)!==c.expected_revision)throw Error('Stale revision');
   result={items:d.args.changes.map(c=>{
    const obj=objects[c.id]={id:c.id,revision:(objects[c.id]?.revision||0)+1,facets:{...objects[c.id]?.facets,...c.facets}};
    return copy(obj);
   })};
  }
  else if(d.method==='chat.status')result={running:false,messages:[{id:'m',role:'assistant',text:'Existing conversation'}]};
  else if(d.method==='system.status')result={signed_in:true};
  else result={};
 }catch(e){error=e.message;}
 event.source.postMessage({agora:true,id:d.id,result,error},'*');
});
</script><iframe src="/shell"></iframe>"""

async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  browser=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox'])
  errors=[]
  async def setup(width=1400):
   page=await browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':900},has_touch=True)
   page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
   await page.route('http://localhost/**',lambda r:r.fulfill(content_type='text/html',body=HTML if r.request.url.endswith('/shell') else BRIDGE))
   await page.goto('http://localhost/')
   frame=page.frames[1]
   await frame.wait_for_selector('.note')
   await frame.wait_for_function('state.draftLoaded && state.connected')
   return page,frame
  async def xy(f):
   return await f.locator('.note').evaluate('(n)=>[parseFloat(n.style.left),parseFloat(n.style.top)]')
  async def start(p,f,dx=60,dy=40):
   box=await f.locator('.note-header').bounding_box()
   x,y=box['x']+32,box['y']+6
   await p.mouse.move(x,y);await p.mouse.down();await p.mouse.move(x+dx,y+dy,steps=5)
   return x,y
  async def settle(f):
   await f.wait_for_function('[...state.notes.values()].every(e=>!e.positionPromise && !e.savePromise)')
  async def moves(p):
   return await p.evaluate("requests.filter(r=>r.method==='world.transact'&&r.args.changes[0].facets['core.appearance'])")
  def passed(name):print('PASS '+name,flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  await f.locator('#chat-input').focus()
  await f.locator('#chat-input').evaluate('(e)=>e.setSelectionRange(2,8)')
  await start(p,f)
  assert await xy(f)==[80,60],await xy(f)
  assert await f.locator('#chat-input').evaluate('(e)=>document.activeElement===e && e.selectionStart===2 && e.selectionEnd===8')
  assert len(await moves(p))==0
  await p.mouse.up();await settle(f)
  assert await p.evaluate("objects.n.facets['core.appearance']")==dict(scene='desk',x=80,y=60,width=245,height=205)
  req=(await moves(p))[0]['args']['changes'][0]
  assert req['expected_revision']==1 and list(req['facets'])==['core.appearance']
  assert await f.locator('#chat-input').input_value()=='Existing unsent draft'
  assert await f.locator('.message-content').inner_text()=='Existing conversation'
  passed('pointer preview, one native-shaped CAS write, focus/selection/chat/draft preserved')
  await p.close()

"""Pointer snapping tests against the retained shell and a simulated bridge.
Run: python tests/snap_browser.py [path/to/index.html]
No live world writes. Also run drag_browser.py for drag/resize/reload regressions.
"""
import asyncio
from drag_browser import HTML, BRIDGE
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BRIDGE = BRIDGE.replace("items:[copy(objects.n)]","items:Object.values(objects).filter(o=>o.facets['core.appearance']).map(copy)")
NOTE = '[data-object-id="n"]'

async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  browser=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox'])
  errors=[]
  async def setup(x=350,y=300,width=1800):
   p=await browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':1000})
   p.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
   await p.route('http://localhost/**',lambda r:r.fulfill(content_type='text/html',body=HTML if r.request.url.endswith('/shell') else BRIDGE))
   await p.goto('http://localhost/')
   f=p.frames[1];await f.wait_for_function('state.draftLoaded && state.connected')
   await p.evaluate("([x,y])=>{objects.q=copy(objects.n);objects.q.id='q';objects.q.facets['core.appearance'].x=x;objects.q.facets['core.appearance'].y=y;}",[x,y])
   await f.evaluate('refresh()')
   return p,f
  async def xy(f):
   return await f.locator(NOTE).evaluate('(e)=>[parseFloat(e.style.left),parseFloat(e.style.top)]')
  async def start(p,f,x,y):
   box=await f.locator(NOTE+' .note-header').bounding_box()
   origin=await xy(f)
   sx,sy=box['x']+32,box['y']+6
   await p.mouse.move(sx,sy);await p.mouse.down()
   await p.mouse.move(sx+x-origin[0],sy+y-origin[1],steps=5)
   return sx-origin[0],sy-origin[1]
  async def settle(f):
   await f.wait_for_function('[...state.notes.values()].every(e=>!e.positionPromise && !e.savePromise)')
  async def moves(p):
   return await p.evaluate("requests.filter(r=>r.method==='world.transact' && r.args.changes.some(c=>c.facets['core.appearance']))")
  async def snapped(f):
   return await f.locator(NOTE).evaluate("(e)=>e.classList.contains('snapped')")

  for side,target in [('right',[607,300]),('left',[93,300]),('below',[350,517]),('above',[350,83])]:
   p,f=await setup()
   neighbor=await p.evaluate('copy(objects.q)')
   await f.locator('#chat-input').focus()
   await f.locator('#chat-input').evaluate('(e)=>e.setSelectionRange(2,8)')
   await start(p,f,target[0]+5,target[1]+7)
   assert await xy(f)==target,(side,await xy(f))
   assert await snapped(f)
   assert len(await moves(p))==0
   assert await f.locator('#chat-input').evaluate('(e)=>document.activeElement===e && e.selectionStart===2 && e.selectionEnd===8')
   await p.mouse.up();await settle(f)
   assert await xy(f)==target and not await snapped(f)
   req=(await moves(p))[0]['args']['changes']
   assert len(req)==1 and req[0]['id']=='n' and req[0]['expected_revision']==1
   assert list(req[0]['facets'])==['core.appearance']
   assert await p.evaluate('objects.q')==neighbor
   assert await f.locator('#chat-input').input_value()=='Existing unsent draft'
   assert await f.locator('.message-content').inner_text()=='Existing conversation'
   await p.evaluate("document.querySelector('iframe').remove();let f=document.createElement('iframe');f.src='/shell';document.body.append(f)")
   f=p.frames[1];await f.wait_for_selector(NOTE)
   assert await xy(f)==target
   await p.close()
   print('PASS '+side+' adjacency: 12px gap, edge alignment, preview, one CAS write, unchanged neighbor, drafts/focus and reopen',flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  ox,oy=await start(p,f,98,307)
  assert await xy(f)==[93,300]
  await p.keyboard.down('Alt')
  assert await xy(f)==[98,307] and not await snapped(f)
  await p.keyboard.up('Alt')
  assert await xy(f)==[93,300] and await snapped(f)
  await p.mouse.move(ox+140,oy+307)
  assert await xy(f)==[140,307] and not await snapped(f)
  await p.mouse.move(ox+98,oy+307)
  assert await snapped(f)
  await p.keyboard.down('Alt');await p.mouse.up();await p.keyboard.up('Alt');await settle(f)
  assert await xy(f)==[98,307]
  assert len(await moves(p))==1
  await p.close()
  print('PASS pull-away releases snapping; Alt toggles preview without motion and bypasses on release',flush=True)

  for mode in ['cancel','refuse','stale','projected']:
   p,f=await setup()
   await start(p,f,98,307)
   if mode=='cancel':
    await p.keyboard.press('Escape');await p.mouse.up()
    assert await xy(f)==[20,20] and len(await moves(p))==0
   else:
    if mode=='refuse':await p.evaluate('refuse=true')
    else:
     await p.evaluate("objects.n.revision++;objects.n.facets['core.appearance'].x=160")
     if mode=='projected':await f.evaluate('refresh()')
    await p.mouse.up();await settle(f)
    assert await xy(f)==([20,20] if mode=='refuse' else [160,20])
    assert await f.locator('#notice').is_visible()
    assert len(await moves(p))==(0 if mode=='projected' else 1)
   assert not await snapped(f)
   await p.close()
  print('PASS snapped preview cancellation, refusal, and stale/concurrent source writes preserve confirmed geometry',flush=True)

  p,f=await setup()
  # Check proximity, overlap, differing sizes, bounds, and nearest-candidate choice.
  result=await f.evaluate("""()=>{
    const n=state.notes.get('n'),q=state.notes.get('q');
    const snap=(x,y)=>snapNotePosition(n,{x,y},245,205);
    const distant=snap(93,0),outside=snap(110,300),partial=snap(98,380);
    paintGeometry(q,{x:350,y:300,width:200,height:180});
    const bottom=snap(98,280),right=snap(310,492);
    const r={id:'r',revision:1,facets:{'core.title':{text:'Third'},'core.text':{text:''},'core.appearance':{scene:'desk',x:350,y:340,width:245,height:205}}};
    createNote(r);
    const nearest=snap(98,337);
    paintGeometry(q,{x:100,y:300,width:200,height:180});
    const negative=snap(0,300);
    return {distant,outside,partial,bottom,right,nearest,negative};
  }""")
  assert not result['distant']['snapped'] and not result['outside']['snapped']
  assert result['partial']==dict(x=93,y=380,snapped=True)
  assert result['bottom']==dict(x=93,y=275,snapped=True)
  assert result['right']==dict(x=305,y=492,snapped=True)

"""Overlapping-note interaction regression; simulated parent bridge only."""
import asyncio
from drag_browser import HTML, BRIDGE
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BRIDGE=BRIDGE.replace("items:[copy(objects.n)]","items:Object.values(objects).filter(o=>o.facets['core.appearance']).map(copy)")
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  browser=await pw.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
  p=await browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1400,'height':900})
  errors=[];p.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
  await p.route('http://localhost/**',lambda r:r.fulfill(content_type='text/html',body=HTML if r.request.url.endswith('/shell') else BRIDGE))
  await p.goto('http://localhost/');f=p.frames[1]
  await f.wait_for_function('state.draftLoaded && state.connected')
  await p.evaluate("""()=>{
   for(const [id,x,y] of [['q',100,70],['r',150,120]]){
    objects[id]=copy(objects.n);objects[id].id=id;
    Object.assign(objects[id].facets['core.appearance'],{x,y});
   }
  }""")
  await f.evaluate('refresh()')
  async def front():
   return await f.evaluate("""()=>{
    const rect=$('desk').getBoundingClientRect();
    return document.elementFromPoint(rect.left+180,rect.top+150).closest('.note').dataset.objectId;
   }""")
  assert await front()=='r'
  # Keep references to detect accidental editor replacement.
  await f.evaluate("window.originalBody=state.notes.get('n').body")
  await f.locator('[data-object-id="n"] .note-title').click()
  assert await front()=='n'
  assert await f.locator('[data-object-id="n"] .note-title').evaluate('(e)=>document.activeElement===e')
  # Click q's exposed right-hand strip; no editor handling may be swallowed.
  b=await f.locator('[data-object-id="q"]').bounding_box()
  await p.mouse.click(b['x']+230,b['y']+20)
  assert await front()=='q'
  # Keyboard navigation into an underlying editor raises it as well.
  await f.locator('[data-object-id="r"] .note-title').focus()
  assert await front()=='r'
  await f.locator('[data-object-id="n"] .note-body').focus()
  await f.locator('[data-object-id="n"] .note-body').evaluate('(e)=>e.setSelectionRange(2,8)')
  assert await front()=='n'
  await f.evaluate('refresh()')
  assert await front()=='n'
  assert await f.evaluate("state.notes.get('n').body===window.originalBody")
  assert await f.locator('[data-object-id="n"] .note-body').evaluate('(e)=>document.activeElement===e && e.selectionStart===2 && e.selectionEnd===8')
  await f.locator('#chat-input').click()
  assert await front()=='n'
  assert await f.locator('#chat-input').input_value()=='Existing unsent draft'
  assert await f.locator('.message-content').inner_text()=='Existing conversation'
  assert await p.evaluate("requests.filter(r=>r.method==='world.transact').length")==0
  assert await f.evaluate("Math.max(...[...state.notes.values()].map(e=>Number(e.node.style.zIndex)))")<=13
  assert not errors,errors
  await browser.close()
  print('PASS exposed clicks, keyboard focus, overlap hit-testing, retained stacking/DOM/selection/drafts, bounded layers and zero native writes')

if __name__=='__main__':asyncio.run(main())
files.CHAT.md:
# Chat presentation

Assistant messages render GitHub-flavored Markdown using vendored Marked 18.0.12
and DOMPurify 3.4.15. HTML is sanitized against a small presentation allowlist;
remote images, executable elements, styles and unsafe links are excluded.
User text remains literal. Code blocks and tables scroll within the chat panel.

chat.status.activity supplies per-message snapshots keyed by turn and item ID.
Commentary and the streaming final answer remain separate. The durable final
replaces its streamed counterpart. Activity includes a tool label and elapsed
time, never raw commands. Progress survives view reload and missed polls within
the current server session; it is transient and resets on the next request or
server restart. No raw reasoning is displayed. Existing note behavior is retained.
